name: cv
title_zh: 同一份经历按地区重排的博士申请简历
tagline_zh: 投美国、欧洲、亚洲的导师前不用手动改顺序——它按地区惯例重排章节，还顺带生成推荐信材料包，省下你反复核对格式的深夜。
tagline_en: Stop reordering sections by hand for each continent. It re-renders your CV per region's norms and bundles the.
desc_en: This skill should be used when a student asks to "write my academic CV", "make a CV for PhD applications", "update my CV", "which order should my CV sections be in", "what do I send my recommender", "recommendation letter packet", "track my recommendation letters", or runs /cv. It extends the shared phd-apply profile with the fields a PhD-application CV needs, renders one version per target region
why_zh: 不是模板填空，而是先读你已有的申请档案，再按目标地区决定章节次序——美国重研究产出，欧洲重学位结构。
why_en: Not a fill-in template. It reads your existing application profile, then reorders sections per regional norms—US favors output.
limit_zh: 只认 phd-apply 共享档案里的字段；没有先建档案就调用，它会直接停下来让你补。只重排章节和生成推荐信包。
limit_en: Only works with fields from the shared phd-apply profile; without it, it stops and asks you to fill it in. Reorders sections and builds the.
title_en: One CV, re-rendered per target region
